source.name: Agmarknet historical daily mandi prices via data.gov.in
source.unit: INR per quintal (100 kg), modal price

method.hold: For each year, the price k months after harvest divided by the harvest-month price, in the same district and marketing year. Median across years; wins = years it paid.
method.index: Ratio to a centred 2x12 moving average, median per calendar month, normalised to mean 1.
